mapper.select: SELECT * FROM students WHERE is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (name, furigana, nickname, email, region, phone_number, age, gender, courses) VALUES (#{name}, #{furigana}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{region}, #{phone_number}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{courses})
INSERT INTO student_courses (student_id, course_name, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
